senses.gloss: f.(b. h.; פלג , v. Delitzsch Genesis4 360) concubine.
units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Ketubot 5:2:3">Y. Keth. V, 29ᵈ</cite> top <he>אשה יש לה כתובה פ׳ אין וכ׳</he> the wife has a marriage contract securing a settlement for her (<cite ref="K01350"><he>כְּתוּבָּה</he></cite>), the concubine has none; (oth. opin.) <he>אשה יש לה כתובה ותנאי כתובה פ׳ וכ׳</he> the wife has a marriage contract containing besides the settlement all conditions of a marriage contract (alimentation &c.), the concubine has the contract but without the conditions; a. fr.—<he>פ׳ בגבעה</he>, v. <cite ref="C00123"><he>גִּבְעָה</he></cite>.—Pl. <he>פִּלַּגְשִׁים</he>, <cite ref="Q01125"><he>פִּילַ׳</he></cite>.

<cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 9">Num. R. s. 9</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="Song of Songs 6:8">Cant. VI, 8</cite>) <he>שמונים … ונקראו פ׳ שהפ׳ חשודות</he> there are eighty families (of nations) that know their mothers but not their fathers, and they are called ‘concubines’, for the concubines are suspected (of faithlessness).
